rules.title: Algorithmic Devices Prohibition - Rent Ordinance Section 37.10C
rules.requirement: Landlords and companies may not sell or use software that analyzes nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units. Tenants or the City Attorney can sue violators.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential units in San Francisco subject to the Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
